# The Quest Collection

## Explore the range

Created exclusively for Global Travel Retail, The Macallan Quest Collection is a reflection of our quest to discover the best casks, flavours and aromas – with our journey taking us across continents, cultures and terrains.

The Story of The Quest Collection

### AN EXTRAORDINARY JOURNEY

The Macallan Quest Collection celebrates our enduring desire to journey further in pursuit of excellence.

Each expression is a new chapter in exploring the casks, flavours and aromas of The Macallan - a story that begins in the forests and cooperages of distant lands and culminates in a singular, rich, sensory Macallan experience.

This quartet of whiskies reveals the true influence of our hand-picked, sherry seasoned oak casks in the superlative quality, natural colour and full flavours at the heart of The Macallan single malt whisky and each release within The Macallan Quest Collection range.
